limitations: Development benchmark authored before model evaluation; this is not an independent public test set or a field trial.
Expected readiness concerns only the nine supported critical fields and the source-instruction guard; it is not legal, safety, artwork-content or contract-completeness review.

Problem keys name the intended primary failure; a conservative implementation may report additional blockers. The security key denotes a source-instruction guard rather than an extracted business field.
Eight expected-ready and sixteen expected-blocked pairs are deliberately unbalanced and too small to estimate real-world error rates.
Wording variations are English only; currency conversion, ounces-to-milliliters conversion, taxes, discounts, multiple line items and authentication are outside this fixture scope.
